# vngcloud_vdb_postgresql_cluster (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vngcloud_vdb_postgresql_cluster" "postgre_cluster" {
  name             = "postgre-cluster"
  engine_version   = "17"
  subnet_id        = "sub-246df886-3ef8-4d70-87e7-6b87f0caea50"
  zone_id          = "HCM03-1A"
  package_id       = data.vngcloud_vdb_postgresql_cluster_package.pg_s_general_2x4.id
  volume_type_id   = data.vngcloud_vdb_postgresql_cluster_volume_type.Gen2_NVMe_IOPS5000.id
  volume_size      = 20
  number_of_nodes  = 3
  public_access    = true
  config_id        = vngcloud_vdb_postgresql_cluster_config_group.postgre_cluster_config.id
  username         = "postgres"
  password         = "abcd1234"
  db_name          = "postgresdb"

  secgroup_rule {
    remote_ip_prefix = "0.0.0.0/0"
    port             = 5432
  }
  secgroup_rule {
    remote_ip_prefix = "10.10.0.0/24"
    port             = 15432
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:

- **name** (String, Required, ForceNew):
    - The name of the PostgreSQL cluster. This field is required and cannot be changed after creation.

- **engine_version** (String, Required, ForceNew):
    - The PostgreSQL datastore version (e.g. `17`). This field is required and cannot be changed after creation.

- **subnet_id** (String, Required, ForceNew):
    - The ID of the subnet where the cluster is provisioned. This field is required and cannot be changed after creation.

- **zone_id** (String, Optional, ForceNew, Computed):
    - Zone ID. Default value: `HCM03-1A`. Allowed values: `HCM03-1A`, `HCM03-1B`, `HCM03-1C`. Cannot be changed after creation.

- **package_id** (String, Required, ForceNew):
    - The ID of the PostgreSQL Cluster flavor (package). Use the `vngcloud_vdb_postgresql_cluster_package` data source to look up. Cannot be changed after creation.

- **volume_type_id** (String, Required):
    - The ID of the PostgreSQL Cluster volume type. Use the `vngcloud_vdb_postgresql_cluster_volume_type` data source to look up. Changing this value triggers a Change volume type operation.

- **volume_size** (Int, Required):
    - The size of the cluster volume in GB. Changing this value triggers a Change volume size operation.

- **number_of_nodes** (Int, Required):
    - The number of nodes in the cluster. Minimum 2 and maximum 10. Changing this value triggers an Edit number of nodes operation.

- **public_access** (Bool, Required):
    - Indicates if the cluster is publicly accessible. Changing this value triggers an enable/disable public access operation.

- **config_id** (String, Optional, Computed):
    - The ID of the configuration group applied to the cluster. Can only be compatible with a config group with a `cluster` deploy type. Changing this value triggers a Change config group operation.

- **username** (String, Required, ForceNew):
    - The master username of the cluster. This field is required and cannot be changed after creation.

- **password** (String, Required, Sensitive):
    - The master password of the cluster. Changing this value triggers a Change password operation.

- **db_name** (String, Required, ForceNew):
    - The name of the initial database. This field is required and cannot be changed after creation.

- **is_poc** (Bool, Optional, ForceNew):
    - Set to `true` if paying with PoC Credit. Cannot be changed after creation.

- **backup_id** (String, Optional, ForceNew):
    - The Backup Point ID used to restore the cluster from an existing backup. Cannot be changed after creation.

- **backup_policy_id** (String, Optional, Computed):
    - The Backup Policy ID applied to the cluster (managed by vBackup). If not set, vBackup will use the default policy for the new cluster. Subsequent changes to this field are managed by the vBackup product and are not reconciled by this resource.

- **backup_location_id** (String, Optional, Computed):
    - The Backup Location ID used by the cluster (managed by vBackup). If not set, vBackup will create a new location for the cluster. Subsequent changes to this field are managed by the vBackup product and are not reconciled by this resource.

- **action** (String, Optional):
    - The action to perform on the cluster. Set to `reboot` to trigger a Reboot operation.

- **secgroup_rule** (List, Optional, Computed): Security group rules controlling network access to the cluster. Each rule contains:
    - **remote_ip_prefix** (String, Required): The remote IP CIDR allowed to access the cluster.
    - **port** (Int, Required): The PostgreSQL listener port. Allowed values: `5432` (read-write), `15432` (read-only).

## Attributes Reference

In addition to all arguments above, the following attributes are exported:

- **id** (String) The ID of the PostgreSQL cluster.

- **engine_type** (String, Computed):
    - The datastore type of the cluster (always `PostgreSQL`).

- **status** (String, Computed):
    - The current status of the cluster (e.g. `ACTIVE`, `BUILDING`, `RESTART_REQUIRED`, ...).

- **volume_type** (String, Computed):
    - The friendly name of the volume type (e.g. `Gen2-NVMe-IOPS5000`).

- **config_name** (String, Computed):
    - The name of the configuration group applied to the cluster.

- **ram** (Int, Computed):
    - The amount of RAM (GB) per node.

- **cpu** (Int, Computed):
    - The number of vCPUs per node.

- **port** (Int, Computed):
    - The read-write port of the cluster.

- **port_ro** (Int, Computed):
    - The read-only port of the cluster.

- **private_rw_ip** (String, Computed):
    - The private read-write IP of the cluster.

- **public_rw_ip** (String, Computed):
    - The public read-write IP of the cluster (only populated when `public_access = true`).

- **private_ro_ip** (String, Computed):
    - The private read-only IP of the cluster.

- **public_ro_ip** (String, Computed):
    - The public read-only IP of the cluster (only populated when `public_access = true`).

- **domain_name** (String, Computed):
    - The domain name of the cluster.

- **bandwidth** (Int, Computed):
    - The network bandwidth (Mbps) of the cluster.

- **free_backup_size** (Int, Computed):
    - The size of the free backup quota in GB.

- **project_id** (String, Computed):
    - The project ID that owns the cluster.

- **deploy_type** (String, Computed):
    - The deploy type of the cluster (always `cluster`).

- **volume_used** (List of String, Computed):
    - The volume usage information of the cluster.

- **secgroup_rule[].id** (String, Computed):
    - The ID of the security group rule.
